**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/06/01 (Thu) 02:53
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Sample Digital Preservation policy document based on best practices with the inclusion of designated communities and principles of digital preservation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The policy outlines practices and procedures for preserving digital assets at [Organization Name].
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The purpose of the policy is to ensure the long-term preservation and accessibility of digital assets for current and future generations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The policy applies to all digital assets created or acquired by [Organization Name], including documents, images, videos, audio recordings, and databases.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] [Organization Name] is responsible for ensuring that digital assets are properly preserved and accessible.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Digital Preservation Team is responsible for implementing and maintaining this policy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] All employees and contractors of [Organization Name] are responsible for following this policy when creating or managing digital assets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A designated community refers to a group of people or organizations that have a particular interest or connection to the digital assets held by [Organization Name].
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples of designated communities may include indigenous communities, community organizations, or descendants of individuals depicted in the digital assets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Digital Preservation Team will work closely with designated communities to ensure that their needs and perspectives are taken into account in the preservation and accessibility of digital assets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Digital assets of particular significance to designated communities will be made available to them in accordance with [Organization Name]'s access and use policies and agreements with the designated communities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] [Organization Name] will adhere to the following principles of digital preservation: authenticity, integrity, confidentiality, and accessibility.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Preservation watch: The organization will monitor and anticipate technological and environmental changes that may impact the preservation of digital assets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Metadata: The organization will create and maintain metadata for all digital assets to ensure discoverability and context.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Legal compatibility: The organization will ensure that digital assets are preserved in a manner that is legally compliant.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Preservation levels: The organization will establish different levels of preservation for digital assets based on their significance and value.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Preservation of data integrity: The organization will ensure that digital assets are preserved in their original state and that any changes to the assets are tracked and documented.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Preservation of authenticity: The organization will ensure that digital assets are authentic, meaning that they are true to the original and
